descriptor: Google Ads account audit, campaign architecture, and conversion readiness
status: Full-month delivery verified; conversion quality and campaign consolidation remain the primary opportunity
signal: Nexla generated 210 clicks from approximately 6,310 impressions on $742.72 in August spend. Average cost per click was $3.54, and Brand Exact produced a 21.06% click-through rate.
goal: Protect Brand performance, consolidate fragmented nonbrand activity, and validate the primary lead signal before scaling budget.

benchmark.detail: August account CPC than the 2026 Business Services search benchmark of $5.87.

work: Completed and delivered the lifetime Google Ads audit with a clear account diagnosis and improvement plan.
Prepared a protected Brand and tightly controlled Nonbrand campaign architecture for the next phase.
Completed a paid-search readiness packet covering landing-page selection, primary conversion definition, and release gates.
Reviewed the embedded lead-form path and current spam-handling needs so reporting can distinguish valid inquiries.
analysis: Brand Exact remains Nexla's clearest demand signal, producing 119 August clicks at a 21.06% click-through rate. The blended account cost per click was materially below the current Business Services benchmark.

Nonbrand engagement remains uneven across MCP, data integration, and data-product themes. The next step is controlled consolidation with a trustworthy primary conversion rather than broader expansion.

platforms.name: Google Ads
platforms.note: Five spending campaigns generated 210 clicks on $742.72. Brand Exact led engagement, while the nonbrand campaigns delivered lower click-through rates and need tighter message-to-landing alignment.

platforms.name: Readiness and measurement
platforms.note: The audit and readiness packet define the Brand and Nonbrand structure, landing-page decisions, and conversion validation needed before expansion.

outcome.platform: Google delivered 210 clicks on $742.72, led by Brand Exact at a 21.06% click-through rate.
outcome.business: Qualified sales conversations, opportunities, and revenue are not reconciled to August platform activity.
outcome.measurement: Confirm the primary conversion and valid lead criteria, then evaluate Brand and Nonbrand performance against qualified pipeline.

workstreams: Lifetime account review and recommendation plan
